verdict.rationale: SES uses standard email protocols, so leaving is easy and most of your data can end up in formats you control. Sending works through standard SMTP and raw MIME (amazon-ses-docs-2, amazon-ses-docs-3). Received mail can be delivered to your own S3 bucket (amazon-ses-docs-7), and sending events can be streamed to Firehose or EventBridge (amazon-ses-docs-10). However, there is no documented 'export all data' capability, and a community report says SES keeps few detailed logs, so users must capture their own history (amazon-ses-comm-1). Missing for 10: a documented bulk export of account data (identities, templates, suppression lists, sending history), explicit open-format export documentation, and independent corroboration of a clean exit path.
